description: This Java source file defines the DhlServices class, which implements DHL shipment services including rate estimation, registration, and shipment confirmation using DHL's ShipIT XML API. It handles XML request/response processing, error handling, and communication with DHL servers.

classes.name: DhlConnectException
classes.description: Custom exception class for DHL connection errors, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: sendDhlRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to DHL server via HTTP POST, returning the XML response as a string.

methods.name: dhlRateEstimate
methods.description: Requests a shipping rate estimate from DHL for a given shipment, returning estimated cost and details.

methods.name: handleDhlRateResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL's XML response to extract rate estimate and error information.

methods.name: dhlRegisterInquire
methods.description: Requests a DHL shipping account registration/shipping key using provided address info.

methods.name: handleDhlRegisterResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL registration response XML to extract the shipping key.

methods.name: dhlShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms a shipment with DHL, obtaining tracking number and label, and updates shipment records.

methods.name: handleDhlShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL shipment confirmation response to extract tracking info and label image, updating database records.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Creates an XML document for DHL access request with credentials and version info.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Processes DHL response XML to extract and record error messages.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for DHL shipment gateway, either from database or properties.
